findings.title: Materials' 116% earnings bet strains credibility
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.72x forward versus 36.06x trailing, a 54 percent compression that implies 116 percent earnings growth. The forward multiple sits at the 30th percentile while trailing sits at the 87th, so the market is pricing a dramatic re-rating that has not yet shown up in reported earnings.

findings.title: Energy's forward multiple ignores trailing strength
findings.body: Energy's trailing P/E of 19.31 is at the 84th percentile, yet the forward multiple of 11.38 sits at the 36th, a 49-point gap. The 41 percent compression implies 70 percent earnings growth, but the market is treating the sector as cheap despite its rich trailing history.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' month-long surge hits extremes
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward percentile jumped 63 points in a month to the 75th, while the trailing percentile sits at 84. The forward P/E of 20.54 is now only 28 percent below trailing, implying 38 percent growth, a bet that the sector's recent earnings momentum will persist.
